core.enemyAggro: standard enemies ignore Beast outside finale exceptions
core.returnBehavior: timer expiry returns player to the chalice/pedestal used to enter Beast Mode
core.reviveBehavior: reviving a teammate in Beast Mode immediately ends that Beast transformation

chargeRules.coOp: normally one usable charge per round per player/pedestal flow; charges can carry/stack according to game state and source observations
chargeRules.solo: up to three Beast uses are available per round in the original solo rules; exact HUD recharge semantics require in-game validation before locking implementation
chargeRules.policy: do not hard-code uncertain charge edge cases until verified in original game

notes: instant and terminates current Beast state

finaleOverride.activeAfter: Shadowman captured with four-player finale active
finaleOverride.duration: infinite until meter depleted by damage or finale resolves
finaleOverride.enemyAggro: purple-mouth Margwas CAN see and attack Beast
finaleOverride.corruption: failing cleanse while in Beast removes a chunk of Beast meter rather than normal-player down behavior
